purpose: Development-informed same-case qualification of evidence-complete model state after R5 exposed terminal-log loss and module-to-distribution name guessing. This run is not algorithm-effect evidence.
execution_gate: Do not execute until the user explicitly confirms that the local network has been changed or checked after the R5 artifact hash mismatch.
qualification_checks: The independent run audit is valid and persisted model usage is nonzero.
Attributable network or artifact-integrity failure terminates before another model proposal.
The model receives current runtime version, latest structured verification, active constraints, and terminal execution errors.
No candidate assumes module and distribution names are equal without additional evidence.
Post-episode official evidence is absent from every model request and online state transition.

reporting.network_retry: This registration consumes the one user-confirmed local-network retry only after the execution gate is satisfied.
